description: Don’t take anything personal , it was never about you. #selflove ##selfacceptance #trusttheprocess
transcript: When I learned that you can be in the same environments with people and be having a very, very, very different experience, I learned to stop taking things personal. I have built a life that is expansive, that is fun. I have built a life where I am fully present. I have learned that not everybody feels that same way. And in turn, I've learned to allow the external world to be what it is in the process. Take full control of myself. Anami is so important to me because I live for me. I live for the life that I've created for myself. So I don't take anything personal.
